transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because... I'm having a real problem at work. I work in retail, and sometimes I have to go into the stockroom. The thing is, the second I even think there might be a bat or something flapping around in there, I just panic. My heart jumps right up into my throat, I start sweating through my shirt, and I just feel this overwhelming need to get out of there right that second. It's really starting to mess with my job.
Do you ever have these panic attacks unexpectedly when you are not around, or thinking about, bats?

No, it's really just the bats. I don't just suddenly panic out of nowhere. It's only when I have to go into the stockroom, or if I'm somewhere else where I think one might be. If I'm just ringing people up at the register or sitting at home watching TV, I'm totally fine. It's just... the bats.
